storyCards.headline: Chained To The Rhythm: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Katy Perry's "Chained To The Rhythm" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Chained To The Rhythm was released in 2017.
